title: Sarapan di Bibir Kawah
subject: a Rinjani porter from Sembalun cooking banana pancakes on the crater rim at dawn while his trekkers go up to the summit
caption: Indonesian Britpop-style alternative pop in the 2000s Nidji arena manner, Coldplay and Killers lineage. A clean electric guitar with dotted-eighth delay ringing a repeating figure; a second overdriven guitar opening wide on the choruses; grand piano pounding quarter-note chords; driving eighth-note bass and big open live drums with floor-tom builds. Wide arena-sized mix with a long plate reverb on the snare. Male tenor vocal, clear and lifted, restrained in the verses and opening into a full-throated chorus. 124 BPM, D major. Wide-open, proud and grateful. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no pop-punk palm-muting, no ballad slowdown.
lyrics:
[Intro - delay guitar and piano]

[Verse 1]
Jam dua pagi tamu-tamu berangkat ke puncak
Aku tinggal di bibir kawah sama kompor dan wajan
Tiga puluh lima kilo kubawa kemarin dari Sembalun
Pakai sandal jepit, bambu di bahu, lagu dangdut di saku

[Pre-Chorus]
Adonan pisang kuaduk pelan-pelan
Kabut masih menutup Segara Anak

[Chorus]
Ini sarapan di bibir kawah
Pancake pisang, teh manis, gulanya dua sendok
Kalian pulang bawa foto dari puncak
Aku di sini lihat danau bangun duluan

[Verse 2]
Tiga ratus kali aku naik gunung ini
Kakiku hafal batu mana yang suka goyang
Anakku di rumah minta oleh-oleh gantungan kunci
Kubilang, bapak cuma bawa pulang bau asap

[Pre-Chorus]
Jaket warna-warni turun dari puncak
Kuangkat wajan, kubalik yang pertama

[Chorus]
Ini sarapan di bibir kawah
Pancake pisang, sedikit gosong di pinggir
Kalian bilang ini paling enak sedunia
Padahal cuma lapar dan udara tipis

[Bridge - guitars swell, drums half-time]
Besok kubawa turun semuanya lagi
Panci, tenda, sampah kalian, sampai ke gerbang desa

[Outro - piano and delay guitar]
Danau sudah bangun
Wajan masih hangat
